identityNote: candidateId is the baseline working identifier, not a promise that an immutable API Activity Code has been allocated. activityCode is null until Tiizi allocates one.

activityCodeAllocation.method: Preserve each exact governed ID from the accepted 118-Activity baseline as the PF-01 Activity Code.
activityCodeAllocation.authority: The baseline assigns all 118 canonical IDs in the PF-01 AAA-AAA-000 format; PF-01 implementation comments specify allocation from governed baseline families. No code was generated, renamed, re-sequenced, or inferred from display names.
activityCodeAllocation.databaseEffect: None. This is canonical inventory identity allocation only. UUIDs and PostgreSQL rows are not allocated or written.
